bundled.built_from: Ubuntu Jammy audacity and audacity-data 2.4.2~dfsg0-5 packages, repacked into bin/, lib/audacity/ and share/. Includes the Audacity executable, scripting module, Nyquist runtime and bundled plugins; upstream file bytes are unchanged in this archive.

modifications: solve.sh rewrites only the scripting module FIFO path template from /tmp/audacity_script_pipe.%s.%d to audacity_script_pipe.%s.%d, with NUL padding, so the endpoint follows PBP_AUDIO_PIPE_DIR. launch.py supplies private configuration and audio defaults. isolation.py confines reference filesystem access and external program execution without changing the upstream binary.
configuration: launch.py writes the Audacity 2.4.2 mod-script-pipe configuration under DATA_DIR/HOME, disables splash, selects Pulse/ALSA and starts the product in PBP_AUDIO_PIPE_DIR (default /tmp) Landlock is required; filesystem rights are limited to those supported by the kernel ABI; the product can write only its instance/exchange directories and execute only its own main executable and dynamic loader. The runtime exposes an explicit reviewed command catalog, only audio-data Export2 formats, and the complete libsndfile header/encoding preference family. Screenshot, diagnostics, benchmarks, macro/code-loading and external-program export channels are unavailable.

scripting_pipe_patch.change: FIFO path template "/tmp/audacity_script_pipe.%s.%d" -> "audacity_script_pipe.%s.%d" (NUL padded); the launcher creates them from PBP_AUDIO_PIPE_DIR so simultaneous sessions of one user stay isolated
